card.title: A Sign We’re Fine
card.instruction: Interpret every laugh, favor, and familiar habit as evidence that the connection is stronger than appearances suggest.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We're dividing our records and you still laughed at my terrible joke.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's a funny joke. It doesn't settle who gets the jazz.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We can disagree over jazz and still get each other. Dinner?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You remember that too. Make it a double; I think we can manage the jazz together.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 reads laughter during division as continuing chemistry, A3 treats disagreement as compatible with connection, and A5 takes the remembered drink as reason to handle the records together.

relationship.evidence: B2 wants the record allocation settled and B4 accepts a limited drink rather than the whole dinner.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4's remembered order to sustain confidence in resolving the actual jazz division.
